headline: Rakuten Viki’s K-Drama Day Returns For The Fourth Year: Celebrate With Free Shows, Special Prizes, Talent Exclusives, And More
summary: Rakuten Viki has launched its fourth annual K-Drama Day, running from September 25 through October 1 with free content, prizes, and exclusive talent features.

headline: xikers Reveals Comeback Date With Teaser For “ROUTE ZERO : The CALLING”
summary: Boy group xikers announced their upcoming comeback by releasing a teaser for their eighth mini-album, "ROUTE ZERO : The CALLING."

headline: Watch: CRAVITY Announces Comeback With Teaser For New EP “sonorous”
summary: K-pop group CRAVITY released a teaser video announcing their upcoming mini album, "sonorous," scheduled for release on September 30.

summary: ENHYPEN secured their seventh music show win and a triple crown for "Bloody Paradise" on the September 10 episode of "M Countdown."

headline: Jung Min Ah And Dong Ha’s Lives Collide Over Fashion And A Hidden Family Secret In “Mission: Mompossible”
summary: The new daily drama “Mission: Mompossible” released a poster highlighting the lives of two mothers and their entangled children.

headline: Andrew Scott to Receive Mill Valley Film Festival’s Acting Award for ‘Elsinore’ (EXCLUSIVE)
summary: Andrew Scott will receive the Mill Valley Film Festival’s Acting Award for his starring role in the upcoming drama “Elsinore.”

headline: Gaza Doc ‘NAZA,’ From ‘No Other Land’ Directors, Earns Record-Breaking 24.5-Minute Venice Ovation as Producer Jonathan Glazer Leads Applause
summary: The Gaza documentary "NAZA" broke Venice Film Festival records with a massive 24.5-minute standing ovation led by producer Jonathan Glazer.

summary: Makers of the Oscar-winning documentary "No Other Land" have released "Naza," a new film exposing Israeli policy in Gaza.
